title: Mortality and Complications in Endovascular Procedures Performed With New Generation Low-profile Devices
official: Mortality and Complications in Endovascular Procedures Performed With New Generation Low-profile Devices
summary: The aim of this study is to observe mortality and complications in procedures in which are used new generation low-profile endoprothesis.

interventions.name: Low profile endoprothesis (Navion Medtronic, NBS Low Profile Bolton Terumo)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with indications for elective TEVAR

Exclusion Criteria:

* Incapability to provide consent
* Patients not eligible for TEVAR
* Pregnancy
sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS
